# HAProxy — servlet-mapping-sse

App at / with the Vaadin servlet on /ui/*, PUSH over Server-Sent Events. The Hilla rule still strips /ui, but Hilla push cannot work at all over SSE: FluxConnection is WebSocket-only with no fallback.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/ui/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

HAProxy config (`haproxy/http/servlet-mapping-sse/vaadin.cfg`), mounted as
`conf.d/10-vaadin.cfg`:

```haproxy
# templates/servlet-mapping.cfg plus a refusal to upgrade: app at /, Vaadin
# servlet on /ui/*, PUSH over Server-Sent Events.
#
# The Hilla rule is still here and still needed for /ui/connect/* — but Hilla
# push cannot work at all in this scenario whatever the proxy does, because
# FluxConnection subscribes with transport and fallbackTransport both set to
# 'websocket'. That is why CI runs the *-sse scenarios with
# -Dit.websocket=false, and why the assertion is skipped rather than failing.
frontend vaadin-in from vaadin-front
    bind :80

    # HAProxy relays an upgrade with no configuration at all and has no keyword
    # to stop it, so the refusal is written out. The 501 comes from the proxy
    # rather than from Atmosphere.
    http-request deny deny_status 501 if { req.hdr(Upgrade) -m found }

    acl hilla path_beg /ui/HILLA/
    acl hilla path_beg /ui/connect/
    http-request replace-path ^/ui(/.*) \1 if hilla

    default_backend vaadin-app

backend vaadin-app from vaadin
    server vaadin vaadin:8080
```

The `global` section, and the two `defaults` sections this file
inherits from, come from the shared
[haproxy-base.cfg](../../haproxy-base.cfg), mounted read-only beside
it as `conf.d/00-base.cfg`. Base and scenario only parse as a pair.
